analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($282.44) vs SMA5/20/50 ($288.17/$294.77/$324.96): below short/mid-term trends, confirming entry into weak territory.
· Below SMA100/200 ($336.44/$337.33) by -16.27%, continued weakening of long-term trend.
· 52-week position (7.6%) + approaching 52-week low ($272.11) range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.0→34.9): oversold territory sustained, downward momentum maintained.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.6957→0.6957): minimal improvement, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $262.31): approaching lower band, 22.02% band width suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($276.92): based on 20-day low, potential for further decline if broken.
· Swing resistance ($291.59): based on SMA5, potential for short-term bounce attempt if breached.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low forming): confirmation of attempted recovery amidst weakness.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.85): subdued compared to 5-day average, reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): downtrend maintained due to sustained oversold RSI and downward break of moving averages. Potential for short-term bounce exists, but trend reversal signals are weak, thus maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
